# Nexus

> An offline-first, encrypted file vault for Windows by P4inz Interactive Labs. AES-256-GCM, Argon2id, no account, no telemetry. Free during the public beta.

- [Features](https://p4inz-code.github.io/nexus-desktop/features.html)
